simple.meaning: עָסִיס (ʻâçîyç) is a Hebrew word meaning “must or fresh grape-juice (as just trodden out).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עָסִיס (H6071) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Song of Songs 8:2, with occurrences in Song of Solomon, Isaiah, Joel, Amos.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָסִיס (H6071) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עָסִיס (H6071) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עָסִיס (ʻâçîyç) / H6071 is traced through Song of Songs 8:2, Isaiah 49:26, Joel 1:5, Joel 4:18 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
